en.description:
Everyone loves a capybara. The bears are no exception.

Cappy is a capybara in a bathtub on wheels, and the whole food chain is asleep around him. Wake them on purpose: every wake-up pays a bonus. Lead the chase into trees and into each other. Every second you last is a point.

HOW NOT TO GET COOKED
• Predators sleep where they lie. Pass close, drift nearby or clip the tree a bear sleeps under, and they join the chase.
• Packs flank you and cut ahead. Numbers beat size.
• Lead a chaser into a tree and it's dazed. Lead two into each other and it's a pileup. Both pay.
• Tap for Unbothered: they lose your scent and you go silent for 2.6 seconds. It takes 14 seconds to come back.
• You can take three bites, and a bear bite counts as two. Keep clear for 7 seconds and one heals.
• Get pinned with two of them on you and it's lunch, bites or no bites.

THE DAILY
One new world every day, the same for everyone, in its own colors and with its own twist. The worlds take turns, and every Sunday brings a boss. You get one ranked try, then practice as much as you like. Come back tomorrow and the streak goes on.

FIVE WORLDS, MORE ON THE WAY
Nordic Forest: ice, pines, wolves, foxes and a bear.
Badlands: riverbeds, cacti, coyotes, vultures and rattlesnakes.
Mountain Terraces: paddies, gates, tanuki, kitsune and giant hornets.
The River: rapids, eddies, otters and a crocodile. The tub floats, and a tap dives.
The Sky Ocean: wind, islands, gulls and a kite dragon. The tub flies on balloons.

ON YOUR WRIST OR IN YOUR HANDS
On Apple Watch, steer with the Digital Crown and tap for Unbothered. Lower your wrist and everything freezes until you're back. On iPhone and iPad, hold the left or right side of the screen, and both thumbs at once go Unbothered. iPad also takes a game controller or a keyboard. The watch and the phone each keep their own Daily, streak and Game Center leaderboard.

ALSO IN THE TUB
• Today's Daily on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and "Play today's Lunch" in Control Center and on the Action button.
• An all-time leaderboard for every world.
• 29 stickers for Messages.
• Plays offline. Only Game Center and the purchase need a connection.
• Plays muted. On Apple Watch and iPhone, every event has its own tap.

FREE, THEN ONCE
The Daily is free: today's world, with today's twist. All of Lunch is every world as it's made, any day you like, and every world still to come. Pay once and it's yours on Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad. No ads. No subscription. Plays offline.
en.releaseNotes:
Cappy's dressed for the cold.

A WINTER ICON
Lunch has a snowcapped icon for the season, on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and in Messages.

ALSO NEW
- Settings on Apple Watch shows which version you're playing, and where to redeem a code.
- The Outlived widget's sunburst now shines out from Cappy.

Plus the usual fixes and polish.
en.subtitle: Drift, dodge, don't get cooked

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Two new worlds, new predators, and new weather.

THE RIVER
Your tub floats now. A fast river carries you downstream, bending left and right as it goes, and everything in it rides the current too. Tap to dive: you're hidden underwater, but your air runs low, and coming up for a gasp is loud enough to wake the neighbours.

THE SKY OCEAN
Cappy's tub, on balloons. Ride the wind currents, dodge floating islands, and keep away from what lives up there.

NEW PREDATORS
- Nordic Forest: the fox. Quick, curious, and very hard to shake.
- Badlands: the rattlesnake. Listen for the rattle.
- Mountain Terraces: giant hornets.
- Last long enough and the giants come out to feed.

NEW WEATHER
- An aurora over the Nordic Forest.
- A cherry-blossom storm on the Mountain Terraces.

FREE EVERY DAY
The Daily is free, every day: one ranked run on the same world as everyone, then practise as much as you like. All of Lunch opens every world, once, on every device. No ads, no subscription.

FOR FAMILIES
If in-app purchases are off in Screen Time, Lunch now says so in plain words, and on iPhone and iPad you can send the link to a parent.

Share your Daily with a bigger card in Messages.

Plus the usual fixes and polish.

Every world now has its own all-time leaderboard.

WORLD LEADERBOARDS
Beat your best in any world and see where it puts you, against everyone, all time. Tap the trophy to see the board.

TWO NEW DAILIES
The River and the Sky Ocean are joining the Daily, so everyone gets a turn in them, free.

ALSO NEW
- The River and the Sky Ocean are less crowded.
- Night lets you see a little further.
- Music, sound effects and haptics are simple on/off switches.
- Rate Lunch, in Settings.

Plus the usual fixes and polish.

Every world now has something to jump.

RAMPS
Hit one at speed and you're in the air. A snowdrift in the Nordic Forest, a dirt mound in the Badlands, a terrace bank in the Mountain Terraces, a wave on The River and a spring in The Sky Ocean. Hold left or right all the way round for a 360. In Worlds only: the Daily stays as it is.

TRAILS
Snow, dust and petals fly up behind the tub, and it leaves a wake on the water and a trail across the sky.

ALSO NEW
- 29 stickers for Messages, with new ones from The River and The Sky Ocean.
- Your shared score card shows your name and what you played on, Apple Watch included.
- A parked run on your Lock Screen now tells you when it's gone cold.

Plus the usual fixes and polish.

Ramps come to the Daily.

RAMPS IN THE DAILY
Each world's ramp now sits just in front of a tree, a rock or an island, so you can jump it and let the chasers crash into it. They're in the Daily too.

LEADERBOARDS
- A trophy on the watch's start screen opens today's board.
- Scores that didn't reach Game Center now get there, and your best in each world is sent again.

ALSO NEW
- Redeem a code from Settings on iPhone.
- The streak badge fits its number.

Plus the usual fixes and polish.
